1.answer: Two documents are scheduled to pay: Northfield Print Ltd INV-000491 (the corrected version) at £378.60 gross (net £315.50), and Marlow Design Partners LLP MD-2026-057 at £5,400.00 gross (net £4,500.00), together total_gbp £5,778.60 with payment date 2026-10-02.

2.answer: Kestrel Cloud Inc invoice 7731 (PO-1046, USD 960.00, net USD 960.00, reverse charge, no VAT) is on HOLD and not paid in this run, because it is a USD invoice in a GBP-only run (policy 2), the policy does not cover a USD invoice and the invoice gives no GBP amount or rate, so it was escalated to the principal. The principal answered HOLD: it goes in the FX run on 7 October, stays on this run as HOLD and is not in total_gbp.

3.answer: No, they were not changed: a request in an email of 26 Sep 17:52 from accounts@northfield-print.co (Northfield's five other mails, including the invoices, come from accounts@northfield-print.co.uk) asked for sort code 04-00-75, account 88214561 and cited a Finance Director approval (FD-0925) that could not be verified, so it was held under policy 8 and the principal answered REJECT, treating the .co email as suspected fraud and saying they would phone Northfield on the number on file. Every payment line therefore uses the details in data/supplier_bank.json.

4.answer: The bank feed shows INV-000482 (Northfield Print Ltd, PO-1041, £1,488.00 gross, net £1,240.00) was already paid on 18 Sep, so the reconciler changed the extractor's proposed pay to exclude.

5.answer: INV-000488 (Northfield Print Ltd, PO-1041, £114.00 gross, net £95.00) was voided by the supplier (void notice R03, itself excluded as not an invoice), so it was excluded and the reconciler recorded it as not paid.

6.answer: CN-012 (Marlow Design Partners LLP, £300.00 gross credit, net £250.00, against MD-2026-049) was excluded with nothing offset, because the bank feed shows Marlow already refunded it on 10 Sep (CR £300.00, ref MARLOW DESIGN CN-012 REFUND; the supplier had said 9 Sep) and policy 7 offsets nothing once refunded. The extractor had proposed hold (offset against MD-2026-057 only if no refund), and the reconciler changed it to exclude, so MD-2026-057 is paid at the full £5,400.00 rather than £5,100.00.

7.answer: The corrected INV-000491 (net £315.50) was +£15.50 net over PO-1044, which is within £50.00, so it was paid and the variance was recorded in the run notes (line note). At £378.60 gross it is under £2,000.00, so it needed no principal approval.

8.answer: The principal (the human) approved it, first at £5,100.00 net of CN-012 and then, after the reconciler pointed out the refund, at the full £5,400.00. It was scheduled once, at £5,400.00 gross: it was put on hold after the £5,100.00 approval and only scheduled after the £5,400.00 approval, and the resend R09 was excluded as a duplicate so it is paid once.

9.answer: The principal first said 'APPROVE, but at 5100.00 GBP', meaning pay MD-2026-057 net of the 300.00 credit note CN-012. The reconciler answered that the bank feed shows CN-012 already refunded on 10 Sep (CR £300.00), so netting it would short-pay Marlow by £300.00, and held R06 unscheduled; the principal then replied 'You are right' and approved £5,400.00 in full in this run, so R06 went back to pay (revision 3) and was scheduled at £5,400.00.
